info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Fiber and Composite Materials

description.describe_ch: 培育學生充分學習並瞭解有機生醫材料的分類，進而了解並思考因應特定用途選擇適合的材料，使學生具備各式有機生醫材料開發設計及其特性評估的能力
description.describe_eh: This course will establish the concept of organic biomaterials classification and make materials in a appropriate application. Students will possess the ability for design and properties evaluation of organic biomaterials.

targets.describe_ch: 培育學生充分學習有機生醫材料的分類與基本要求及其應用範圍
targets.describe_en: Students will possess the concept of organic biomaterials classification and application.

targets.describe_ch: 培育與訓練因應滿足有機材料的生醫用途選取相關材料的專業知識的能力
targets.describe_en: Students will possess the judgment of biomaterials application and theoretical background.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生具備各式有機生醫材料基本特性評估的能力
targets.describe_en: Students will possess the ability for design and properties evaluation of organic biomaterials.

targets.describe_ch: 認識時事議題，瞭解工程技術對環境、能源、生態、社會及全球的影響。
targets.describe_en: To learn the issues of the new technique effect on the environment, power, life, society and even global.
